user.title: Connect GetMyMeter
user.description: Enter the same username and password you use on getMyMeter. The integration signs in and discovers your meter automatically.

data_description.password: Your getMyMeter portal password. Home Assistant stores integration credentials in the config entry.

meter.title: Select meter
meter.description: This portal account has more than one meter. Select the meter to add.

reauth_confirm.title: Sign in to GetMyMeter
reauth_confirm.description: Enter your getMyMeter username and password. This one-time step replaces the expired manually copied token; future session renewal is automatic.

reconfigure.title: Update GetMyMeter credentials
reconfigure.description: Enter the current getMyMeter username and password. The configured meter will be rediscovered automatically.

error.cannot_connect: Unable to reach or read the GetMyMeter portal. Try again later.
error.invalid_auth: The GetMyMeter username or password was rejected.
error.unknown: Unexpected error while connecting to GetMyMeter.

abort.already_configured: This GetMyMeter meter is already configured.
abort.unknown: The GetMyMeter setup flow could not continue.
abort.wrong_account: Those credentials do not provide access to the meter already configured in this entry.

reauth_required.message: GetMyMeter credentials are missing or were rejected; sign in again.
